knowledge.text: The current edit's anti-revisit/stall clause did not remove repeated visits in Candidate runs: on train:0030 the Candidate re-entered countertop 1 (Q1:8, Q1:12, Q1:17) and cabinet 1 (Q1:14, Q1:18) before reaching the target; on train:0036 it cycled among coffeetable 1, sidetable 1, sidetable 2 and drawers 1-2 for most of the episode (e.g., Q7:10, Q7:11, Q7:14, Q7:15, Q7:20, Q7:26, Q7:30) before finally reaching tvstand 1 at Q7:42; and on train:0035 it cycled drawers 1-8 and countertop 1 (e.g., Q6:19, Q6:23, Q6:34, Q6:38, Q6:47, Q6:50). Because the Actor sees only the current observation, the admissible actions and the last two pre-action observation/action pairs and keeps no persistent notes, whether the clause was ignored or was simply too narrow (its 'last one or two observed steps' window) to suppress longer cycles cannot be separated.
